sourceNote: Sword & Shield era estimate, RECALIBRATED against the two large primary studies that exist for this era: the TCGplayer Authentication Center's 8,000+-pack openings of Evolving Skies (swsh7, Aug 2021) and Lost Origin (swsh11, Sep 2022). Those two independent samples agree closely tier by tier - plain V 10.56% and 11.63%, the VMAX plus full-art/alt-art band 9.48% and 8.32%, and the secret rainbow/gold band 2.05% in BOTH - so this set uses their midpoints: double_rare 11.0%, ultra_rare 8.9%, hyper_rare 2.05%. This REPLACES an earlier community-aggregate guess that put hyper_rare at 4.2%, roughly double what both measured studies found, which inflated every Sword & Shield set's EV. Confidence stays LOW deliberately: the numbers are now anchored to real measurements, but they are measurements of two OTHER sets in the same era, not of this one - per-set rates do vary, and no primary study of this set has been found. Tier averages also assume every card in a tier is equally likely, which understates the headline chases (in Evolving Skies the Umbreon VMAX alt is about 1 in 2,000 packs, far rarer than a uniform tier implies), so the residual error runs conservative.
